repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

One more item for this card, from PR #36383's delta contract review on head 04d28e04 (N3). The rule for which decision branches name a step has two copies. `decisionBranchTechnicalTargets` in `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` restates the edge test of `decisionBranches` in the UI's `flow-branches.ts`, including its own copy of the `default` label, because lint cannot import the UI package. They agree today, but nothing holds them together. While this card touches the step-name readers, move the predicate into `@objectstack/spec/automation` beside `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` so both sides read it. If that isn't possible, add a parity pin and a back-pointer comment on each side.
